SELECT COUNT(*) AS CNT
              FROM   [dbo].[SCM_MST_TITLESET_USER] U WITH(NOLOCK)
              WHERE  1 = 1
              AND    U.PROGRAM_ID = 'FP02510'
              AND    U.SHEET_NAME = 'Main'
              AND    U.USER_ID    = 'jaeuk.shin'
              AND    U.USER_INQUIRY_COLUMN_TYPE_CODE = 'C';

SELECT C.PROGRAM_ID
              , C.SHEET_NAME
              , C.COLUMN_NAME
              , C.COLUMN_LABEL_NAME
              , C.SORT_ORDER_NO        --CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), U.SORT_ORDER_NO) AS SORT_ORDER_NO
              , C.DATA_SORT_METHOD_CODE
              , C.SMALL_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
              , C.LARGE_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
              , '' AS DAY_CODE
              , C.FIXED_FLAG
              , C.COLUMN_WIDTH
              , C.CELL_CONTROL_OBJECT_TYPE_CODE
              , C.CELL_COMBO_DATA_TYPE
              , C.DATA_SCALE_NUMBER
              , C.DATA_MAX_LENGTH
              , C.HORIZONTAL_ALIGN_CODE
              , C.UPPERCASE_APPLY_FLAG
              , C.VISIBLE_FLAG
              , C.DEFAULT_FLAG
              , C.USER_SELECTABLE_FLAG
              , C.VALID_YN
              , C.ATTRIBUTE1
              , C.ATTRIBUTE2
              , C.ATTRIBUTE3
              , C.ATTRIBUTE4
              , C.ATTRIBUTE5
              , C.ATTRIBUTE6
              , C.ATTRIBUTE7
              , C.ATTRIBUTE8
              FROM   [dbo].[SCM_MST_SHEET_COLUMNS] C WITH(NOLOCK)
              WHERE  1 = 1
              AND    C.PROGRAM_ID  = 'FP02510'
              AND    C.SHEET_NAME  = 'Main'
              AND    C.DEFAULT_FLAG = 'Y'
              AND    C.VISIBLE_FLAG = 'Y'
              AND    C.VALID_YN     = 'Y'

              , '' AS DAY_CODE

              , C.CELL_COMBO_DATA_TYPE
              , C.DATA_SCALE_NUMBER
              , C.DATA_MAX_LENGTH
